commit.message:
Give the controller spawners a parameter file (#3851)

* moveit_configs_utils: give the controller spawners a parameter file

generate_spawn_controllers_launch starts each spawner with only the
controller name. The controller_manager node reads
ros2_controllers.yaml, but the controller nodes do not read it. Each
controller therefore starts with no parameters and fails to initialize.
The user can plan a motion, but the user cannot run it.

The spawner program has a --param-file option. The option loads the file
into the controller node before configuration. This commit gives the
option to each spawner.

generate_demo_launch already uses the same path convention for the
ros2_control_node. This commit reuses that convention. The code omits
the option if the file does not exist, so a config package without
ros2_controllers.yaml keeps the old behavior.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Give a parameter file to the controller spawners in this repository

The utility function now has callers, but 12 launch files in this
repository create their spawners directly. They have the same defect, so
this commit corrects them too.

Four moveit_servo demo launch files spawn the same controllers that
generate_spawn_controllers_launch() creates, and they use the same
configuration package. They now call the utility function instead. The
utility function takes an optional controller_manager_timeout, because
these demos start the controller manager themselves and must wait longer
than the default.

The other eight launch files cannot use the utility function without a
change of behavior:

* prbt_moveit_config and the hybrid planning test spawn
  panda_joint_group_position_controller, which is not the controller in
  moveit_controllers.yaml.
* The move_group tests also spawn panda_hand_controller.
* The remaining tests stage each spawner with a TimerAction or an event
  handler, which the utility function does not reproduce.

Each of those files gets --param-file directly. Every file already holds
the correct path in ros2_controllers_path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* prbt_moveit_config: spawn the controller that the configuration defines

demo.launch.py spawns panda_joint_group_position_controller. The
variable that holds the node is named prbt_arm_controller_spawner, and
prbt_ros_controllers.yaml defines prbt_arm_controller, not the panda
one. prbt_controllers.yaml also maps MoveIt to prbt_arm_controller.

The requested controller therefore has no type and cannot load. This
commit spawns prbt_arm_controller.

This defect is older than this branch. It became visible once the
spawner received the parameter file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* trajectory_cache: give the spawners a parameter file

The two trajectory_cache fixtures start their spawners with
ExecuteProcess and a shell command, not with a Node action. The earlier
commits looked only for the Node form, so these two files kept the
defect.

Both files already hold the correct path in ros2_controllers_path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* trajectory_cache: pass the spawner command as an argument list

The previous commit put the parameter file path into a shell command
string. A path that holds a space or a shell metacharacter would split
before --param-file received it.

These two fixtures were the only launch files in the repository that ran
a shell. Every other launch file gives an argument list to a Node
action. This commit gives ExecuteProcess an argument list as well, so no
shell reads the path and no quoting is necessary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Fix FloatingJointModel::getMaximumExtent(): cover full rotation range (#3854)

Rotation range is 0..180° (or 0..pi). Drop factor of 0.5.

Before 83ff55a4 the rotation distance was acos(|dot|), a half-angle in [0, pi/2], 
so the 0.5 was correct then and was missed when the consumer changed.
